Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

Summary
- Goal: Validate Redwood's security posture for FinBank's LLM inference use (production, PII handling, regulated workflows).
- Key asks you raised: SOC 2 status/scope, GDPR/HIPAA posture, vendor security questionnaire, incident response (IR) and breach notification timelines, and BCP/DR evidence.

Requests / next steps
1) SOC 2: Attached is our SOC 2 summary (SOC2-Redwood-summary-2026.pdf). Can you confirm whether you need the full Type II report or a scoped SOC 2 (audit firm name and period noted in the summary)?
2) Vendor questionnaire: I attached a blank copy of the questionnaire we suggest (FinBank-Vendor-Questionnaire.xlsx) — happy to fill or have your team send the preferred format.
3) Incident response & breach notification: Please confirm your required notification windows (you mentioned legal wants regulator notification timelines). We can provide our IR playbook and a timeline for initial customer notification and regulator escalation.
4) BCP/DR evidence: We can provide DR test summaries, RTO/RPO targets, and contacts for on-call escalation. Please list the specific artifacts you need (e.g., recent DR test report, DR runbook excerpts, RTO/RPO targets).

Attachments included: SOC2-Redwood-summary-2026.pdf, FinBank-Vendor-Questionnaire.xlsx

Proposed internal owners
- I will coordinate the questionnaire and follow-ups (naomi_feldman).
- Jordan will pull IR/BCP artifacts and lead technical responses.
- Marissa will coordinate SOC artifacts and compliance items.

Would you be available for a 30-minute follow-up early next week to walk through the IR playbook and agree on timelines? Suggest Mon/Tue (morning PST).

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the recap and the attachments. A few clarifications so we can triage internally: 

SOC 2
- Please confirm the audit period and whether this is a full SOC 2 Type II with operational controls for availability and confidentiality. We will likely need the full report under NDA; the summary is helpful for initial review.

HIPAA/GDPR
- Our legal team needs to confirm HIPAA applicability for the specific workflows discussed. Can you provide any attestations or third-party assessments related to PHI handling?

Incident response / breach notification
- Our security policy expects: initial customer notification within 24 hours of confirmed impact to customer data, and regulator notification within 72 hours when required by law (we'll confirm regulator specifics). For vendor security reviews we also need to see your incident playbook and evidence of recent incident post-mortems (redacted).

BCP/DR
- For BCP/DR evidence we typically request: most recent DR test summary (date and pass/fail), RTO/RPO targets for critical services, and the DR runbook contact list (names/roles/emails/phone). If you have a one-page DR summary that covers these, that would work for initial review.

Questionnaire / timeline
- Legal prefers we complete vendor questionnaires within 30 calendar days, but security does an initial technical review in ~10 business days. I'll ask security@finbank.com to confirm exact artifacts required.

Can you also provide a point-in-time contact and primary escalation for IR (name, role, mobile)? We will need that for our vendor intake.

If you can provide the IR playbook and DR summary this week, we can start the 10-business-day technical review. A follow-up call on Tue morning PST works for me — please send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Alice Wong
Head of Vendor Security | FinBank Inc.
alice.wong@finbank.com
